verdict.rationale: Conductor's 'routines' feature explicitly lets agents run on a schedule or via GitHub Action, and docs describe agents that test, fix, and run builds without step-by-step confirmation, plus cloud sandboxes that keep working after the laptop closes — directly matching the always-on/autonomous story. However, this is all first-party changelog/docs; there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that scheduled routines reliably maintain/fix software over time, and the community thread (pre-dating routines) never discusses this capability. Missing for 10: independent verification of routines working in practice, detail on trigger types beyond schedule/GitHub Action, and evidence of sustained autonomous maintenance outcomes.
